segments.ja537:1.1: “Kasmā tuvaṃ rasaka edisāni, karosi kammāni sudāruṇāni;
segments.ja537:1.3: Hanāsi itthī purise ca mūḷho, maṃsassa hetu adu [ādu (sī. syā.)] dhanassa kāraṇā”.
segments.ja537:2.1: “Naṃ attahetū na dhanassa kāraṇā, na puttadārassa sahāyañātinaṃ;
segments.ja537:2.3: Bhattā ca me bhagavā bhūmipālo, so khādati maṃsaṃ bhadantedisaṃ”.
segments.ja537:3.1: “Sace tuvaṃ bhatturatthe payutto, karosi kammāni sudāruṇāni;
segments.ja537:3.3: Pātova antepuraṃ pāpuṇitvā, lapeyyāsi me rājino sammukhe taṃ”.
segments.ja537:4.1: “Tathā karissāmi ahaṃ bhadante, yathā tuvaṃ [yameva tvaṃ (sī.)] bhāsasi kāḷahatthi;
segments.ja537:4.3: Pātova antepuraṃ pāpuṇitvā, vakkhāmi te rājino sammukhe taṃ”.
segments.ja537:5.1: Tato ratyā vivasāne [vivasane (sī. syā. pī.)], sūriyuggamanaṃ pati;
segments.ja537:5.5: Upasaṅkamma [upasaṅkamitvā (sī. syā. pī.)] rājānaṃ, idaṃ vacanamabravi.
segments.ja537:9.1: “Evaṃ pamatto rasagārave ratto [rato (sī. syā. pī.)], bālo yadī āyati nāvabujjhati;
segments.ja537:9.3: Vidhamma putte caji [cajitvā (ka.)] ñātake ca, parivattiya attānaññeva [attānameva (sī. pī.)] khādati.
segments.ja537:10.1: “Idaṃ te sutvāna vigetu [vihetu (sī. pī.)] chando, mā bhakkhayī [mā bhakkhasī (sī. pī.)] rāja manussamaṃsaṃ;
segments.ja537:10.3: Mā tvaṃ imaṃ kevalaṃ vārijova, dvipadādhipa [dipadādipa (sī. pī.) evamuparipi] suññamakāsi raṭṭhaṃ”.
segments.ja537:11.1: “Sujāto nāma nāmena, oraso tassa atrajo [tassa orasa atrajo (sī.), tassa atraja oraso (pī.)];
segments.ja537:12.3: Aladdhā mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ, maññe hissāmi [hessāmi (sī. syā.), hassāmi (pī.)] jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja537:13.3: Na tvaṃ arahasi tāta, abhakkhaṃ bhakkhayetave”.
segments.ja537:14.1: “Rasānaṃ aññataraṃ etaṃ, kasmā [yasmā (sī. pī.)] maṃ tvaṃ nivāraye;
segments.ja537:14.3: Sohaṃ tattha gamissāmi, yattha lacchāmi edisaṃ.
segments.ja537:15.3: Yassa me dassanena tvaṃ, nābhinandasi brāhmaṇa”.
segments.ja537:16.3: Tvañca jamma vinassassu, yattha pattaṃ na taṃ suṇe”.
segments.ja537:17.3: Pabbājessanti taṃ raṭṭhā, soṇḍaṃ māṇavakaṃ yathā”.
segments.ja537:18.3: Accharaṃ kāmayantova, na so bhuñji na so pivi.
segments.ja537:20.3: Aladdhā mānusaṃ maṃsaṃ, maññe hissāmi jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja537:21.3: Abhuttaparibhogena [avuttiparibhogena (sī. pī.), ayuttaparibhogena (syā.)], sabbe abbhatthataṃ gatā.
segments.ja537:22.3: Abhakkhaṃ rāja bhakkhesi, tasmā pabbājayanti taṃ”.
segments.ja537:23.1: “Tiṭṭhāhīti mayā vutto, so tvaṃ gacchasi pammukho [pāmukho (ka.)];
segments.ja537:23.5: Idaṃ te samaṇāyuttaṃ, asiñca me maññasi kaṅkapattaṃ”[kaṅkhapattaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja537:24.3: Corañca loke aṭhitaṃ vadanti, āpāyikaṃ nerayikaṃ ito cutaṃ.
segments.ja537:25.1: “Sace tvaṃ saddahasi [sacepi sahasi (sī. pī.)] rāja, sutaṃ gaṇhāhi khattiya [khattiyaṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja537:25.3: Tena yaññaṃ yajitvāna, evaṃ saggaṃ gamissasi”.
segments.ja537:26.1: “Kismiṃ nu raṭṭhe tava jātibhūmi [jātabhūmi (sī.)], atha kena atthena idhānupatto;
segments.ja537:26.3: Akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etamatthaṃ, kimicchasī demi tayajja patthitaṃ”.
segments.ja537:27.3: Taveva atthāya idhāgatosmi, suṇohi gāthā paramatthasaṃhitā”.
segments.ja537:28.1: “Na ve rudanti matimanto sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭṭhānacintino;
segments.ja537:28.3: Dīpañhi etaṃ paramaṃ narānaṃ, yaṃ paṇḍitā sokanudā bhavanti.
segments.ja537:29.1: “Attānaṃ ñātī udāhu [uda (sī. pī.)] puttadāraṃ, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ;
segments.ja537:29.3: Kimeva tvaṃ [kimo nu tvaṃ (sī. pī.)] sutasomānutappe, korabyaseṭṭha vacanaṃ suṇoma tetaṃ’.
segments.ja537:30.1: “Nevāhamattānamanutthunāmi, na puttadāraṃ na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ;
segments.ja537:30.3: Satañca dhammo carito purāṇo, taṃ saṅkaraṃ [saṅgaraṃ (sī. syā. pī.) evamuparipi] brāhmaṇassānutappe.
segments.ja537:31.1: “Kato mayā saṅkaro brāhmaṇena, raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena;
segments.ja537:32.3: Amittahatthaṃ punarāvajeyya, korabyaseṭṭha na hi maṃ upesi.
segments.ja537:33.1: “Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā, gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī;
segments.ja537:33.3: Madhuraṃ piyaṃ jīvitaṃ laddha rāja, kuto tuvaṃ ehisi me sakāsaṃ”.
segments.ja537:34.1: “Mataṃ vareyya parisuddhasīlo, na jīvitaṃ [na hi jīvitaṃ (sī.)] garahito pāpadhammo;
segments.ja537:34.3: Na hi taṃ naraṃ tāyati [tāyate (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] duggatīhi, yassāpi hetu alikaṃ bhaṇeyya.
segments.ja537:35.1: “Sacepi vāto girimāvaheyya, cando ca sūriyo ca chamā pateyyuṃ;
segments.ja537:35.3: Sabbā ca najjo paṭisotaṃ vajeyyuṃ, na tvevahaṃ rāja musā bhaṇeyyaṃ.
segments.ja537:36.1: [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati]“Nabhaṃ phaleyya udadhīpi susse, saṃvaṭṭaye bhūtadharā vasundharā;
segments.ja537:36.3: Siluccayo meru samūlamuppate, na tvevahaṃ rāja musā bhaṇeyyaṃ”[ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati].
segments.ja537:37.1: “Asiñca sattiñca parāmasāmi, sapathampi te samma ahaṃ karomi;
segments.ja537:37.3: Tayā pamutto anaṇo bhavitvā, saccānurakkhī punarāvajissaṃ”.
segments.ja537:38.1: “Yo te kato saṅkaro brāhmaṇena, raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena;
segments.ja537:39.1: “Yo me kato saṅkaro brāhmaṇena, raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena;
segments.ja537:40.1: “Mutto ca so porisādassa hatthā, gantvāna taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca;
segments.ja537:40.3: Suṇoma [suṇomi (sī. syā.)] gāthāyo satārahāyo, yā me sutā assu hitāya brahme”.
segments.ja537:41.3: Sā naṃ saṅgati pāleti, nāsabbhi bahusaṅgamo.
segments.ja537:42.3: Sataṃ saddhammamaññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
segments.ja537:43.1: “Jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīrampi jaraṃ upeti;
segments.ja537:43.3: Satañca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
segments.ja537:44.1: “Nabhañcaṃ dūre pathavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tadāhu dūre;
segments.ja537:44.3: Tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti, satañca dhammo [dhammaṃ (sī. pī.)] asatañca rāja”.
segments.ja537:45.1: “Sahassiyā [sahassiyo (sī. pī.)] imā gāthā, nahimā [na imā,(sī. pī.) nayimā (syā.)] gāthā satārahā;
segments.ja537:45.3: Cattāri tvaṃ sahassāni, khippaṃ gaṇhāhi brāhmaṇa”.
segments.ja537:46.1: “Āsītiyā nāvutiyā [asītiyā navutiyā (pī.)] ca gāthā, satārahā cāpi bhaveyya [bhaveyyu (sī. syā. pī.)] gāthā;
segments.ja537:46.3: Paccattameva sutasoma jānahi, sahassiyā nāma kā atthi [sahassiyo nāma idhatthi (sī.)] gāthā”.
segments.ja537:47.1: “Icchāmi vohaṃ sutavuddhimattano, santoti maṃ [santo mamaṃ (syā.), santo ca maṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] sappurisā bhajeyyuṃ;
segments.ja537:47.3: Ahaṃ savantīhi mahodadhīva, na hi tāta tappāmi subhāsitena.
segments.ja537:48.1: “Aggi yathā tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ dahanto, na tappatī sāgarova [sāgaro vā (sī. pī.)] nadīhi;
segments.ja537:48.3: Evampi te paṇḍitā rājaseṭṭha, sutvā na tappanti subhāsitena.
segments.ja537:49.1: “Sakassa dāsassa yadā suṇomi, gāthaṃ ahaṃ atthavatiṃ [gāthā ahaṃ atthavatī (sī. pī.)] janinda;
segments.ja537:49.3: Tameva sakkacca nisāmayāmi, na hi tāta dhammesu mamatthi titti”.
segments.ja537:50.1: “Idaṃ te raṭṭhaṃ sadhanaṃ sayoggaṃ, sakāyuraṃ sabbakāmūpapannaṃ;
segments.ja537:50.3: Kiṃ kāmahetu paribhāsasimaṃ [bhāsase maṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], gacchāmahaṃ porisādassa ñatte”[porisādassa kante (sī. pī.), porisādassupante (ka.)].
segments.ja537:51.1: “Attānurakkhāya bhavanti hete, hatthārohā rathikā pattikā ca;
segments.ja537:51.3: Assāruhā [assārohā (syā. pī.)] ye ca dhanuggahāse, senaṃ payuñjāma hanāma sattuṃ”.
segments.ja537:52.1: “Sudukkaraṃ porisādo akāsi, jīvaṃ gahetvāna avassajī maṃ;
segments.ja537:52.3: Taṃ tādisaṃ pubbakiccaṃ saranto, dubbhe ahaṃ tassa kathaṃ janinda”.
segments.ja537:53.1: “Vanditvā so pitaraṃ mātarañca, anusāsetvā negamañca balañca;
segments.ja537:53.3: Saccavādī saccānurakkhamāno, agamāsi so yattha porisādo”.
segments.ja537:54.1: “Kato mayā saṅkaro brāhmaṇena, raṭṭhe sake issariye ṭhitena;
segments.ja537:55.1: “Na hāyate khāditaṃ [khādituṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] mayhaṃ pacchā, citakā ayaṃ tāva sadhūmikāva [sadhūmakā ca (syā.)];
segments.ja537:55.3: Niddhūmake pacitaṃ sādhupakkaṃ, suṇoma [suṇomi (sī.), suṇāma (pī.)] gāthāyo satārahāyo”.
segments.ja537:56.1: “Adhammiko tvaṃ porisādakāsi [porisādamakāsi (ka.)], raṭṭhā ca bhaṭṭho udarassa hetu;
segments.ja537:56.3: Dhammañcimā abhivadanti gāthā, dhammo ca adhammo ca kuhiṃ sameti.
segments.ja537:57.3: Natthi saccaṃ kuto dhammo, kiṃ sutena karissasi”.
segments.ja537:58.1: “Yo maṃsahetu migavaṃ careyya, yo vā hane purisamattahetu;
segments.ja537:58.3: Ubhopi te pecca samā bhavanti, kasmā no [kasmā nu (ka.)] adhammikaṃ brūsi maṃ tvaṃ”.
segments.ja537:59.3: Abhakkhaṃ rāja bhakkhesi, tasmā adhammiko tuvaṃ”.
segments.ja537:60.1: “Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā, gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī;
segments.ja537:60.3: Amittahatthaṃ punarāgatosi, na khattadhamme kusalosi rāja”.
segments.ja537:61.1: “Ye khattadhamme kusalā bhavanti, pāyena te nerayikā bhavanti;
segments.ja537:61.3: Tasmā ahaṃ khattadhammaṃ pahāya, saccānurakkhī punarāgatosmi;
segments.ja537:62.3: Sabbaṃ tahiṃ labhasi [labbhati (pī.)] sāmitāya, saccena kiṃ passasi ānisaṃsaṃ”.
segments.ja537:63.1: “Ye kecime atthi rasā pathabyā, saccaṃ tesaṃ sādhutaraṃ rasānaṃ;
segments.ja537:63.3: Sacce ṭhitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca, taranti jātimaraṇassa pāraṃ”.
segments.ja537:64.1: “Mutto tuvaṃ porisādassa hatthā, gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī;
segments.ja537:64.3: Amittahatthaṃ punarāgatosi, na hi nūna te maraṇabhayaṃ janinda;
segments.ja537:64.5: Alīnacitto asi [ca’ si (sī. syā. pī.)] saccavādī”.
segments.ja537:65.1: “Katā me kalyāṇā anekarūpā, yaññā yiṭṭhā ye vipulā pasatthā;
segments.ja537:65.3: Visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
segments.ja537:66.1: “Katā me kalyāṇā anekarūpā, yaññā yiṭṭhā ye vipulā pasatthā;
segments.ja537:66.3: Anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ ada [khāda (sī. syā. pī.)] maṃ porisāda.
segments.ja537:67.1: “Pitā ca mātā ca upaṭṭhitā me, dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ;
segments.ja537:67.3: Visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
segments.ja537:68.1: “Pitā ca mātā ca upaṭṭhitā me, dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ;
segments.ja537:68.3: Anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ ada maṃ porisāda.
segments.ja537:69.1: “Ñātīsu mittesu katā me kārā [katūpakāro (syā. ka.)], dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ;
segments.ja537:69.3: Visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
segments.ja537:70.1: “Ñātīsuṃ mittesu katā me kārā, dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ;
segments.ja537:70.3: Anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ ada maṃ porisāda.
segments.ja537:71.1: “Dinnaṃ me dānaṃ bahudhā bahūnaṃ, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca;
segments.ja537:71.3: Visodhito paralokassa maggo, dhamme ṭhito ko maraṇassa bhāye.
segments.ja537:72.1: “Dinnaṃ me dānaṃ bahudhā bahūnaṃ, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca;
segments.ja537:72.3: Anānutappaṃ paralokaṃ gamissaṃ, yajassu yaññaṃ ada maṃ porisāda”.
segments.ja537:73.3: Muddhāpi tassa viphaleyya [vipateyya (sī. pī.)] sattadhā, yo tādisaṃ saccavādiṃ adeyya”.
segments.ja537:74.3: Api gāthā suṇitvāna, dhamme me ramate [ramatī (sī. pī.)] mano”.
segments.ja537:75.3: Sā naṃ saṅgati pāleti, nāsabbhi bahusaṅgamo.
segments.ja537:76.3: Sataṃ saddhammamaññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
segments.ja537:77.1: “Jīranti ve rājarathā sucittā, atho sarīrampi jaraṃ upeti;
segments.ja537:77.3: Satañca dhammo na jaraṃ upeti, santo have sabbhi pavedayanti.
segments.ja537:78.1: “Nabhañcaṃ dūre pathavī ca dūre, pāraṃ samuddassa tadāhu dūre;
segments.ja537:78.3: Tato have dūrataraṃ vadanti, satañca dhammo [dhammaṃ (sī. pī.)] asatañca rāja”.
segments.ja537:79.1: “Gāthā imā atthavatī subyañjanā, subhāsitā tuyha janinda sutvā;
segments.ja537:79.3: Ānandi vitto sumano patīto, cattāri te samma vare dadāmi”.
segments.ja537:80.1: “Yo nattano maraṇaṃ bujjhasi tuvaṃ [bujjhase tvaṃ (sī. pī.), bujjhase tuvaṃ (syā.)], hitāhitaṃ vinipātañca saggaṃ;
segments.ja537:80.3: Giddho rase duccarite niviṭṭho, kiṃ tvaṃ varaṃ dassasi pāpadhamma.
segments.ja537:81.1: “Ahañca taṃ dehi varanti vajjaṃ, tvañcāpi datvāna avākareyya;
segments.ja537:81.3: Sandiṭṭhikaṃ kalahamimaṃ vivādaṃ, ko paṇḍito jānamupabbajeyya”.
segments.ja537:82.1: “Na taṃ varaṃ arahati jantu dātuṃ, yaṃ vāpi datvāna avākareyya;
segments.ja537:82.3: Varassu samma avikampamāno, pāṇaṃ cajitvānapi dassameva”.
segments.ja537:83.1: “Ariyassa ariyena sameti sakhyaṃ [sakkhi (sī. syā. pī.)], paññassa paññāṇavatā sameti;
segments.ja537:83.3: Passeyya taṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ [ārogyaṃ (ka.)], etaṃ varānaṃ paṭhamaṃ varāmi”.
segments.ja537:84.1: “Ariyassa ariyena sameti sakhyaṃ, paññassa paññāṇavatā sameti;
segments.ja537:84.3: Passāsi maṃ vassasataṃ arogaṃ, etaṃ varānaṃ paṭhamaṃ dadāmi”.
segments.ja537:85.3: Na tādise bhūmipatī adesi, etaṃ varānaṃ dutiyaṃ varāmi”.
segments.ja537:86.3: Na tādise bhūmipatī ademi, etaṃ varānaṃ dutiyaṃ dadāmi”.
segments.ja537:87.1: “Parosataṃ khattiyā te gahitā, talāvutā assumukhā rudantā;
segments.ja537:87.3: Sake te raṭṭhe paṭipādayāhi, etaṃ varānaṃ tatiyaṃ varāmi”.
segments.ja537:88.1: “Parosataṃ khattiyā me gahitā, talāvutā assumukhā rudantā;
segments.ja537:88.3: Sake te raṭṭhe paṭipādayāmi [sakena raṭṭhena paṭipādayāmi te (sī.)], etaṃ varānaṃ tatiyaṃ dadāmi”.
segments.ja537:89.1: “Chiddaṃ te raṭṭhaṃ byathitā [byathitaṃ (sī.), byādhitaṃ (pī.)] bhayā hi, puthū narā leṇamanuppaviṭṭhā;
segments.ja537:89.3: Manussamaṃsaṃ viramehi [viramāhi (syā.)] rāja, etaṃ varānaṃ catutthaṃ varāmi”.
segments.ja537:90.1: “Addhā hi so bhakkho mama [mamaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] manāpo, etassa hetumhi [hetumpi (pī.)] vanaṃ paviṭṭho;
segments.ja537:90.3: Sohaṃ kathaṃ etto upārameyyaṃ, aññaṃ varānaṃ catutthaṃ varassu”.
segments.ja537:91.1: “Naṃ ve piyaṃ meti janinda tādiso, attaṃ niraṃkacca [niraṃkatvā (sī. syā. pī.)] piyāni sevati;
segments.ja537:91.3: Attāva seyyo paramā ca [paramāva (bahūsu) jā.1.6.81 saṃsandetabbaṃ] seyyo, labbhā piyā ocitatthena [ocitattena (ka.)] pacchā”.
segments.ja537:92.3: Namhi sakkā [namhi sakko (sī. pī.)] nivāretuṃ, aññaṃ [aññaṃ tuvaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] varaṃ samma varassu”.
segments.ja537:93.1: “Yo ve piyaṃ meti piyānurakkhī [piyānukaṅkhī (sī. pī.)], attaṃ niraṃkacca piyāni sevati;
segments.ja537:93.3: Soṇḍova pitvā visamissapānaṃ [pītvana visassa thālaṃ (sī. pī.), pitvā visamissathālaṃ (syā. ka.)], teneva so hoti dukkhī parattha.
segments.ja537:94.1: “Yo cīdha saṅkhāya piyāni hitvā, kicchenapi sevati ariyadhamme [ariyadhammaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja537:94.3: Dukkhitova pitvāna yathosadhāni, teneva so hoti sukhī parattha”.
segments.ja537:95.1: “Ohāyahaṃ pitaraṃ mātarañca, manāpiye kāmaguṇe ca [kāmaguṇepi (syā. ka.)] pañca;
segments.ja537:95.3: Etassa hetumhi vanaṃ paviṭṭho, taṃ te varaṃ kinti mahaṃ dadāmi”.
segments.ja537:96.1: “Na paṇḍitā diguṇamāhu vākyaṃ, saccappaṭiññāva bhavanti santo;
segments.ja537:96.3: Varassu samma iti maṃ avoca, iccabravī tvaṃ na hi te sameti”.
segments.ja537:97.1: “Apuññalābhaṃ ayasaṃ akittiṃ, pāpaṃ bahuṃ duccaritaṃ kilesaṃ;
segments.ja537:97.3: Manussamaṃsassa kate [bhavo (syā. ka.)] upāgā, taṃ te varaṃ kinti mahaṃ dadeyyaṃ.
segments.ja537:98.1: “Naṃ taṃ varaṃ arahati jantu dātuṃ, yaṃ vāpi datvāna avākareyya;
segments.ja537:98.3: Varassu samma avikampamāno, pāṇaṃ cajitvānapi dassameva”.
segments.ja537:99.1: “Pāṇaṃ cajanti santo nāpi dhammaṃ, saccappaṭiññāva bhavanti santo;
segments.ja537:99.3: Datvā varaṃ khippamavākarohi, etena sampajja surājaseṭṭha.
segments.ja537:100.1: “Caje dhanaṃ [dhanaṃ caje (sī.)] aṅgavarassa hetu [yo pana aṅgahetu (sī. pī.)], aṅgaṃ caje jīvitaṃ rakkhamāno;
segments.ja537:100.3: Aṅgaṃ dhanaṃ jīvitañcāpi sabbaṃ, caje naro dhammamanussaranto”.
segments.ja537:101.1: “Yasmā hi dhammaṃ puriso vijaññā, ye cassa kaṅkhaṃ vinayanti santo;
segments.ja537:101.3: Taṃ hissa dīpañca parāyaṇañca, na tena mittiṃ jirayetha [jarayetha (sī. pī.)] pañño.
segments.ja537:102.1: “Addhā hi so bhakkho mama manāpo, etassa hetumhi vanaṃ paviṭṭho;
segments.ja537:102.3: Sace ca maṃ yācasi etamatthaṃ, etampi te samma varaṃ dadāmi.
segments.ja537:103.1: “Satthā ca me hosi sakhā ca mesi, vacanampi te samma ahaṃ akāsiṃ;
segments.ja537:103.3: Tuvampi [tvaṃpi (syā. ka.)] me samma karohi vākyaṃ, ubhopi gantvāna pamocayāma”.
segments.ja537:104.1: “Satthā ca te homi sakhā ca tyamhi, vacanampi me samma tuvaṃ akāsi;
segments.ja537:104.3: Ahampi te samma karomi vākyaṃ, ubhopi gantvāna pamocayāma”.
segments.ja537:105.3: Na jātu dubbhetha imassa rañño, saccappaṭiññaṃ me paṭissuṇātha”.
segments.ja537:106.3: Na jātu dubbhema imassa rañño, saccappaṭiññaṃ te paṭissuṇāma”.
segments.ja537:107.1: “Yathā pitā vā atha vāpi mātā, anukampakā atthakāmā pajānaṃ;
segments.ja537:107.3: Evameva vo [evameva (sī.), evampi vo (syā.)] hotu ayañca rājā, tumhe ca vo hotha yatheva puttā”.
segments.ja537:108.1: “Yathā pitā vā atha vāpi mātā, anukampakā atthakāmā pajānaṃ;
segments.ja537:108.3: Evameva no hotu [evampi no (syā.)] ayañca rājā, mayampi hessāma yatheva [tatheva (pī.)] puttā”.
segments.ja537:109.1: “Catuppadaṃ sakuṇañcāpi maṃsaṃ, sūdehi randhaṃ sukataṃ suniṭṭhitaṃ;
segments.ja537:109.3: Sudhaṃva indo paribhuñjiyāna, hitvā katheko ramasī araññe.
segments.ja537:110.3: Indaṃva devesu pamodayiṃsu, hitvā katheko ramasī araññe.
segments.ja537:111.1: “Tambūpadhāne bahugoṇakamhi, subhamhi [sucimhi (sī. pī.)] sabbassayanamhi saṅge [saññate (sī. pī.), laṅgate (syā.)];
segments.ja537:111.3: Seyyassa [sayanassa (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] majjhamhi sukhaṃ sayitvā, hitvā katheko ramasī araññe.
segments.ja537:112.1: “Pāṇissaraṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ nisīthe, athopi ve nippurisampi tūriyaṃ;
segments.ja537:112.3: Bahuṃ sugītañca suvāditañca, hitvā katheko ramasī araññe.
segments.ja537:113.3: Hayehi nāgehi rathehupetaṃ, hitvā katheko ramasī araññe”.
segments.ja537:115.3: Akāsiṃ pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, yena gacchāmi duggatiṃ.
segments.ja537:117.3: Kāhāmi kusalaṃ kammaṃ, yena gacchāmi suggatiṃ.
segments.ja537:118.1: “Thale yathā vāri janinda vuṭṭhaṃ [vaṭṭaṃ (sī. pī.)], anaddhaneyyaṃ na ciraṭṭhitīkaṃ;
segments.ja537:118.3: Evampi hoti asataṃ samāgamo, anaddhaneyyo udakaṃ thaleva.
segments.ja537:119.1: “Sare yathā vāri janinda vuṭṭhaṃ, ciraṭṭhitīkaṃ naravīraseṭṭha [naraviriyaseṭṭha (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja537:119.3: Evampi ve [evampi me (syā.), evampi ce (pī. ka.)] hoti sataṃ samāgamo, ciraṭṭhitīko [ciraṭṭhitikaṃ (ka.)] udakaṃ sareva.
segments.ja537:120.1: “Abyāyiko hoti sataṃ samāgamo, yāvampi tiṭṭheyya tatheva hoti;
segments.ja537:120.3: Khippañhi veti asataṃ samāgamo, tasmā sataṃ dhammo asabbhi ārakā”.
segments.ja537:121.1: “Na so rājā yo [rājā na so yo (ka.)] ajeyyaṃ jināti, na so sakhā yo sakhāraṃ jināti;
segments.ja537:121.3: Na sā bhariyā yā patino na vibheti, na te puttā [puttā na te (ka.)] ye na bharanti jiṇṇaṃ.
segments.ja537:122.1: “Na sā sabhā yattha na santi santo, na te santo [santo na te (ka.)] ye na bhaṇanti dhammaṃ;
segments.ja537:122.3: Rāgañca dosañca pahāya mohaṃ, dhammaṃ bhaṇantāva bhavanti santo.
segments.ja537:124.3: Subhāsitaddhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo”ti.
segments.ja537:128.1: Sumukho pana haṃsavaro ca mahā, sudhabhojaniko ca paro pavaro;
